title: 서머턴 맨

images.prompt: A 1949 police storeroom at night: a pale white plaster bust of a man's head and shoulders on a wooden shelf, seen strictly from directly behind so only the smooth back of the plaster head and shoulders are visible, no face visible at all, a single warm orange accent light, dark ceiling above.

Evening on a long sandy beach in South Australia, 1948: a low concrete sea wall running along the sand, a row of old street lamps glowing along the esplanade, calm waves, two tiny faceless silhouettes strolling far away in the distance, nobody lying anywhere, empty sea wall, dusk sky above.

Early grey morning on an empty sandy beach in South Australia, 1948: an empty low concrete sea wall in soft fog, a few tiny faceless silhouettes standing far away beside it seen from a great distance, no lying figure, no body, nothing on the sand, cold light.

Close-up under a desk lamp in a 1940s police office: the inside collar of a man's 1940s jacket laid on a wooden table, the spot where the maker's label should be has been neatly cut out leaving a small rectangular gap with loose threads; beside it an empty space on the table where a wallet should be.

A 1949 railway station cloakroom in Adelaide: long wooden shelves crowded with old suitcases and bags, and one brown leather suitcase set apart alone on the counter under a single hanging lamp, dim, nobody there.

An open old brown leather suitcase on a wooden counter under lamplight: neatly folded 1940s shirts and trousers inside, the label spots on each garment visibly cut away with small rectangular gaps and loose threads, a spool of bright orange thread on top.

Close-up under warm lamplight: the inside collar of a folded 1940s white shirt with a small plain cloth tag stitched inside bearing only faint smudged ink marks, completely illegible, no letters, no characters, the rest of the garment plain.

Close-up of the inside waistband of old 1940s men's trousers on a table: a tiny secret pocket sewn into the waistband, the end of a tightly rolled scrap of paper peeking out of it, lamp light, no hands.

Inside a dark 1940s car at night seen from the back seat, full frame edge to edge with no borders: a small old book lying face down on the leather back seat, lit by a street lamp glow through the side window, faint pencil marks in five short lines across its back cover, blurred and unreadable.

An abstract dark navy space filled with a vast glowing network of thousands of tiny connected dots and thin lines like a family tree spreading outward, one single dot glowing bright orange near the middle.

A cosy night archive room: Boogi the small owl archivist sits at a wooden desk under a little amber lantern, an open large ledger in front of him, a folded old shirt with a cut-out label beside the ledger, a dark window showing a night sea.

youtube.title: 상표 잘린 옷의 남자, 경찰은 얼굴을 본떴다
youtube.summary: 1948년 호주 애들레이드의 해변. 이름이 될 만한 것이 하나도 없던 남자의 옷에서, 상표는 모두 잘려 있었습니다. 갈아입을 옷까지.
youtube.pinned: 상표를 다 잘라 낸 그 옷들, 몇 벌에만 남아 있던 이름. 기억나세요?

threads: 1948년 호주 해변에서 이름 없는 남자가 발견됐어. 지갑도 신분증도 없었고, 입고 있던 옷 상표가 전부 잘려 있었대.
해가 바뀌고 역 보관소에서 아무도 안 찾아간 가방이 나왔는데, 그 안에 든 갈아입을 옷까지 상표가 다 잘려 있었어. 근데 몇 벌에만 이름이 하나 남아 있었대. 'T. Keane'. 그 이름으로도 그 사람은 끝내 못 찾았고.
몇 달 뒤엔 바지 속에 꿰맨 숨은 주머니에서 돌돌 만 쪽지가 나와. 시집 마지막 장에서 찢어 낸 두 단어. 그 시집은 누군가의 차에서 나왔는데, 뒤표지에 연필로 쓴 다섯 줄이 있었어. 이건 지금도 아무도 못 풀었어.
이름을 끝내 몰라서 경찰이 얼굴을 석고로 본떠 뒀는데, 70년 뒤에 그 석고에 박힌 머리카락으로 연구진이 한 사람을 지목했대. 경찰 공식 확인은 아직이고.
상표를 다 잘라 낸 옷에, 왜 그 이름만 남아 있었을까. 영상으로 보려면 인스타 @ossak_alarm 에서 봐.
hook_type: 지운 흔적×남은 하나(상표 전부 잘린 옷)
